latestVersion.changelog:
AI Image Video Creator — Initial Release

- Turn images or video clips (JPG, PNG, MP4, MOV, and more) into AI-generated 1080p MP4 videos.
- Simple automatic setup: connects to cloud API and manages session/token flow for you.
- Supports file uploads up to 500MB; optimized for marketers and content creators.
- Handles editing commands (transitions, background music, text overlays) via natural language.
- Exports processed videos in ~1-2 minutes with cloud GPU rendering.
- Tracks credit usage, session state, and provides clear error handling for common issues.
